Fractal Smithing
Batches: refill inputs that change
In a queued batch, if the recipe transforms an item (empty crucible -> crucible with metal), the next craft looks for the new item instead of failing.
Charcoal burner: minutes per batch
Game minutes a lit burner needs to turn one batch (e.g. 2 logs) into 12 charcoal.
Charcoal burner: capacity (kg)
Weight capacity of the burner inventory. A log weighs 9 kg; 90 kg is 10 logs, yielding 60 charcoal (48 kg).
Charcoal burner: inventory and automatic production
The charcoal burner gets an inventory and turns wood into charcoal on its own. Disabled, the burner behaves as in vanilla.
Charcoal burner: only produces while lit
If disabled, the burner produces charcoal even when unlit or without fuel.
Materials from the floor, containers and bags
Recipes excluded from the above
Internal recipe names separated by semicolons (e.g. CastSteelBar;ForgeBarIntoHalves). Those recipes keep moving materials to the inventory as in vanilla.
Any recipe (vanilla or from another mod) uses materials where they are: on the floor, in a container within 2.5 tiles or in a bag, without moving them to the main inventory first.
Heavy results to the floor (kg, 0 = never)
Recipe results weighing this much or more (e.g. a crucible full of molten metal) are placed on the floor at the character's feet instead of the inventory.
Furnace: automatic smelting
The furnace gets an inventory and smelts whatever is left inside (crucible, scrap and charcoal), one vanilla recipe at a time, without the player standing there.
Furnace: minutes per recipe
Game minutes each automatic smelting recipe (one piece of scrap) takes.
Furnace: capacity (kg)
Weight capacity of the furnace inventory. A full crucible weighs 15 kg.
Furnace: fill one crucible before starting another
With several crucibles inside, each recipe goes into the fullest crucible that is not complete yet. Disabled, the first one found is used and the metal spreads across them.
Furnace: overflow goes to the next crucible

If a recipe adds more uses than the crucible can hold (e.g. 4 into one at 19/20), it is filled to the maximum and the rest goes into another non-full crucible. Disabled, the overflow is lost as in vanilla.
Furnace: require tongs inside
Automatic smelting requires the recipe tools (tongs) to be inside the furnace inventory. They are not consumed.
Mechanics: parts and tools from the floor, containers and bags

When installing vehicle parts, the part and the tools are used where they are (floor, nearby container or bag) without moving them to the main inventory. Uninstalled parts above the 'Heavy results to the floor' weight are placed on the floor.
Mine rocks in the world
Mining: ore chance from a plain rock (%%)
Chance, for each type, that an ordinary boulder also drops iron ore, copper ore, flint or a large stone. 0 disables it.
Mining: noise radius
How many tiles the mining is heard from, attracting zombies. 0 disables it, which is the default.
Mining: maximum ore per node
Largest yield from an iron, copper, flint or limestone node.
Mining: minimum ore per node
Smallest yield from an iron, copper, flint or limestone node.
Mining: seconds per rock
How long it takes to break one rock with the tool in hand.
Mining: maximum stones
Largest number of small stones any rock drops.
Mining: minimum stones
Smallest number of small stones any rock drops.
Lets you break the boulders and ore nodes the game scatters around the map with a pickaxe, a sledgehammer or a stone maul. Vanilla places them but gives you no way to harvest them.
Status in the context menu
The burner and furnace context menu shows an entry with load, current recipe, embers and progress.
Progress bars on items
Items the next batch will consume show a 'Charring' / 'Smelting' bar in the inventory.
Tools do not limit batch crafting
With this option, hammers, chisels, tongs and other 'kept' recipe tools only need to be present once and never limit the quantity or the MAX button.
